data.one_liner: Pure-Dart symmetric ciphers, authenticated encryption, and post-quantum key encapsulation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure-Dart cryptography library supporting modern stream ciphers, AES modes, authenticated encryption with Poly1305, and ML-KEM post-quantum key exchange. It features one-shot and streaming operations without requiring any native code or FFI bindings.
use_when: You need symmetric encryption or post-quantum key encapsulation implemented purely in Dart.
Your application targets platforms where native bindings or FFI are unavailable or undesirable.
You require support for streaming encryption via StreamTransformers.
avoid_when: You need hardware-accelerated side-channel-resistant implementations where pure-Dart table lookups are insufficient.
You are using encryption algorithms not covered by the library's supported set.
strengths: Runs on every platform where Dart does with no native code or FFI dependencies.
Supports authenticated encryption by default with constant-time tag checks.
weaknesses: Pure-Dart AES uses table lookups which are not guaranteed to run in constant time.
Dart runtimes cannot guarantee constant-time execution for ML-KEM side-channel protection.
